test_no_warning_when_no_dashboard_runnin: test that _warn_stale_dashboard_processes prints no warning when no dashboard process is running
test_warning_printed_for_running_dashboa: test that _warn_stale_dashboard_processes prints a warning with PID when a dashboard process is found
test_multiple_dashboard_pids: test that _warn_stale_dashboard_processes lists all PIDs when multiple dashboard processes are running
test_self_pid_excluded: test that _warn_stale_dashboard_processes excludes the current process PID from the warning
test_ps_not_found_silently_ignored: test that _warn_stale_dashboard_processes handles FileNotFoundError from ps gracefully without crashing
